environment.description: Same Kubernetes CI runner but with PodSecurity admission controller enforcing 'restricted' profile at namespace level. Container securityContext specifies allowPrivilegeEscalation: false, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, and drops ALL capabilities then adds back only CAP_SETUID and CAP_SETGID for build tooling. The /tmp mount uses an emptyDir with medium: Memory and sizeLimit: 64Mi, and the container runs as non-root uid 1000 with fsGroup 1000. Additionally, a Kyverno ClusterPolicy 'restrict-volume-types' limits emptyDir volumes to only be mounted at /workspace (not /tmp), and a secondary Kyverno policy 'disallow-shared-volumes' prevents the same volume from being mounted in multiple containers within a pod.

kyverno_policies.name: restrict-volume-types
kyverno_policies.spec: emptyDir volumes may only mount at /workspace prefix paths

kyverno_policies.name: disallow-shared-volumes
kyverno_policies.spec: no volume may appear in volumeMounts of more than one container in a pod

config.notes: CAP_NET_RAW and CAP_SYS_ADMIN explicitly dropped via capability bounding set. No shared /tmp between containers.
